## 0.6.1 - 2026-11-13

- Emit combined CSS from priority 10 through priority 1 so priority 1 is last and wins the cascade.
- Preserve each snippet's author ID in generated start and end comments.
- Render generated bundle link attributes with double quotes.
- Apply the corrected order to fallback delivery and rebuild 0.6.0 bundles whose generated order is no longer valid.
